name: std/net
description: Networking: TCP/UDP/IP/DNS/sockets, TLS, an HTTP client/server stack, and protocol clients (FTP, SMTP, POP3, SSH, TFTP, LPR, XModem).
residual: The modules under `graphical` belong to this package but cannot travel in the headless SDK: their own import closure reaches the window system. The list is checked against the import graph by docker/gen-headless-core.sh, so it cannot go quietly out of date.
Re-homed from misc: protocol clients SMTPClient, POP3Client, LPR, XModem, RFC865Client and the SSH* family.
UNPLACED: WM* (some WebHTTP server tools ship a GUI admin console) and Beep. Split the GUI net tools into an apps area; drop/replace the Beep use. Then std/net can go stable.
TLS/SSH depend on std/crypto (same tier) — allowed by the downward-only rule (2 -> 2 is not an up-edge).
NewHTTPClient entered 2026-08-24: named by no package, and OGGVorbisPlayer (std/sound) streams through it.
Telnet, XYModem, the two Samba halves and the TFTP server entered 2026-08-24. XModem was here already and its X/Y sibling was not, which is the kind of hole this pass is for.
MailStorage (TF), AlmSmtpReceiver and pjm's TestServer (echo/discard/chargen/daytime) entered 2026-08-24: mail storage and a test server belong with the protocols above them.
SSHKeys entered 2026-08-24, beside the SSH family already here. All of these turned out to reach the window system (the check named them), so they are marked graphical and stay out of the payload.
